'''''Solar Fire''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that operated in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. They had a rivalry with the crew of the [[Invisible Star|''Black Hole'']] that led to the crews being separated when the two ships were docked at [[Lormar 23]].<ref name="Flashpoint! Brak Sector">''[[Flashpoint! Brak Sector]]''</ref>
